content: The Northstar Cache Modernization Project Overview Northstar Analytics operates a cloud-based platform that processes telemetry from manufacturing plants, delivery fleets, and regional warehouses. Customers use the platform to monitor equipment health, identify shipping delays, and detect unusual changes in energy consumption.

Customers use the platform to monitor equipment health, identify shipping delays, and detect unusual changes in energy consumption. By early 2026, the platform was receiving more than twelve million events per hour.

By early 2026, the platform was receiving more than twelve million events per hour. Most events entered the system through the Atlas Gateway, were written to the Aurora Event Log, and were then processed by the Meridian Analytics Engine.

Most events entered the system through the Atlas Gateway, were written to the Aurora Event Log, and were then processed by the Meridian Analytics Engine. Although the system remained functional, customer dashboards had become slower during periods of heavy traffic.
Although the system remained functional, customer dashboards had become slower during periods of heavy traffic. The main source of delay was repeated access to the Orion Metadata Store.

The main source of delay was repeated access to the Orion Metadata Store. Meridian frequently requested equipment profiles, customer permissions, site configuration, and recent alert history from Orion.

Meridian frequently requested equipment profiles, customer permissions, site configuration, and recent alert history from Orion. Many of these requests asked for the same information within a short period, but the platform did not maintain a shared cache.

Many of these requests asked for the same information within a short period, but the platform did not maintain a shared cache. Each Meridian worker kept a small local cache, so one worker could not reuse data already fetched by another worker.

Each Meridian worker kept a small local cache, so one worker could not reuse data already fetched by another worker. This increased database traffic and caused uneven response times across the analytics cluster.
This increased database traffic and caused uneven response times across the analytics cluster. To address the problem, Northstar created the Cache Modernization Project.

To address the problem, Northstar created the Cache Modernization Project. The project introduced a distributed cache called Helios, changed how Meridian retrieved metadata, and added new monitoring through the Sentinel Observability Service.

The project introduced a distributed cache called Helios, changed how Meridian retrieved metadata, and added new monitoring through the Sentinel Observability Service. The initial project team included Maya Chen, the principal systems engineer; Luis Romero, the database reliability lead; Priya Nair, the platform architect; and Owen Brooks, the incident-response manager.

The initial project team included Maya Chen, the principal systems engineer; Luis Romero, the database reliability lead; Priya Nair, the platform architect; and Owen Brooks, the incident-response manager. Maya designed the cache protocol, Luis evaluated the effects on Orion, Priya coordinated changes across services, and Owen prepared rollback and recovery procedures.

Maya designed the cache protocol, Luis evaluated the effects on Orion, Priya coordinated changes across services, and Owen prepared rollback and recovery procedures. Existing Architecture The Atlas Gateway accepts telemetry from customer devices and performs authentication, schema validation, and basic rate limiting.

Existing Architecture The Atlas Gateway accepts telemetry from customer devices and performs authentication, schema validation, and basic rate limiting. Valid events are appended to the Aurora Event Log.

Valid events are appended to the Aurora Event Log. Aurora preserves the original event order for each customer account and allows multiple downstream services to consume the same event stream independently.

Aurora preserves the original event order for each customer account and allows multiple downstream services to consume the same event stream independently. Meridian reads events from Aurora and applies customer-specific processing rules.

Meridian reads events from Aurora and applies customer-specific processing rules. For example, a temperature reading may be compared against an equipment profile, while a shipping scan may be checked against a warehouse schedule.
For example, a temperature reading may be compared against an equipment profile, while a shipping scan may be checked against a warehouse schedule. These rules depend on metadata stored in Orion.
These rules depend on metadata stored in Orion. Orion is a replicated relational database containing account settings, device records, permissions, alert thresholds, and site configuration.

Orion is a replicated relational database containing account settings, device records, permissions, alert thresholds, and site configuration. Before Helios was introduced, a Meridian worker contacted Orion whenever the required metadata was absent from its local memory.
Before Helios was introduced, a Meridian worker contacted Orion whenever the required metadata was absent from its local memory. The local cache expired records after thirty seconds.
The local cache expired records after thirty seconds. This reduced some repeated reads, but it was ineffective when related events were handled by different workers.

This reduced some repeated reads, but it was ineffective when related events were handled by different workers. During traffic spikes, thousands of workers requested the same popular records from Orion.

During traffic spikes, thousands of workers requested the same popular records from Orion. The database replicas remained available, but query latency increased and connection pools approached their limits.

The database replicas remained available, but query latency increased and connection pools approached their limits. Luis found that approximately sixty-four percent of Meridian’s metadata queries requested records that another worker had fetched during the previous two minutes.

Luis found that approximately sixty-four percent of Meridian’s metadata queries requested records that another worker had fetched during the previous two minutes. He concluded that a shared cache could remove a large portion of the duplicate traffic.
He concluded that a shared cache could remove a large portion of the duplicate traffic. However, he warned that stale permissions or configuration could produce incorrect analytics results.

However, he warned that stale permissions or configuration could produce incorrect analytics results. The project therefore treated consistency as a primary requirement rather than simply maximizing cache hit rate.

The project therefore treated consistency as a primary requirement rather than simply maximizing cache hit rate. Helios Design Helios is a distributed, in-memory cache positioned between Meridian and Orion.
Helios Design Helios is a distributed, in-memory cache positioned between Meridian and Orion. It stores frequently requested metadata and makes cached records available to every Meridian worker.
It stores frequently requested metadata and makes cached records available to every Meridian worker. Helios divides records into partitions based on customer account identifiers.
Helios divides records into partitions based on customer account identifiers. Each partition has one primary node and two replica nodes.
Each partition has one primary node and two replica nodes. The primary accepts writes, while replicas serve reads when they are sufficiently up to date.
The primary accepts writes, while replicas serve reads when they are sufficiently up to date. When Meridian requires metadata, it first sends a lookup request to Helios.
When Meridian requires metadata, it first sends a lookup request to Helios. If Helios contains a valid record, it returns the cached value and records a cache hit.
If Helios contains a valid record, it returns the cached value and records a cache hit. If the record is missing or expired, Helios records a cache miss and requests the value from Orion.
If the record is missing or expired, Helios records a cache miss and requests the value from Orion. The returned value is placed in the appropriate partition before it is sent back to Meridian.
The returned value is placed in the appropriate partition before it is sent back to Meridian. This process is called cache fill.
This process is called cache fill. Priya required Helios to preserve tenant isolation.
Priya required Helios to preserve tenant isolation. Records from one customer account must never be returned to another account, even if two customers use the same equipment identifier.

Records from one customer account must never be returned to another account, even if two customers use the same equipment identifier. For this reason, Helios constructs each cache key from the customer account, record type, and record identifier.

For this reason, Helios constructs each cache key from the customer account, record type, and record identifier. The account identifier is therefore part of both partition selection and key construction.
The account identifier is therefore part of both partition selection and key construction. The cache uses different expiration policies for different metadata categories.
The cache uses different expiration policies for different metadata categories. Equipment descriptions expire after ten minutes because they change infrequently.
Equipment descriptions expire after ten minutes because they change infrequently. Alert thresholds expire after two minutes.
Alert thresholds expire after two minutes. Permission records expire after thirty seconds because delayed permission changes carry greater risk.

Permission records expire after thirty seconds because delayed permission changes carry greater risk. Sentinel monitors expiration behavior and reports when the observed lifetime of a record exceeds its configured policy.

Sentinel monitors expiration behavior and reports when the observed lifetime of a record exceeds its configured policy. Invalidation and Consistency Expiration alone was not sufficient for records that required rapid updates.
Invalidation and Consistency Expiration alone was not sufficient for records that required rapid updates. Northstar therefore added an invalidation stream.
Northstar therefore added an invalidation stream. Whenever Orion commits a change to a cacheable record, the database publishes an invalidation event to Aurora.
Whenever Orion commits a change to a cacheable record, the database publishes an invalidation event to Aurora. Helios consumes these events and removes the corresponding cached records.
Helios consumes these events and removes the corresponding cached records. The invalidation path involves several components.
The invalidation path involves several components. Orion first commits the database transaction.
Orion first commits the database transaction. It then writes an outbox record in the same transaction.
It then writes an outbox record in the same transaction. The Relay Service reads the outbox, publishes the invalidation event to Aurora, and marks the outbox record as delivered.

The Relay Service reads the outbox, publishes the invalidation event to Aurora, and marks the outbox record as delivered. Helios receives the event from Aurora and removes the affected key from the primary partition and its replicas.

Helios receives the event from Aurora and removes the affected key from the primary partition and its replicas. This design prevents a database change from being committed without a durable record of the required invalidation.
This design prevents a database change from being committed without a durable record of the required invalidation. If the Relay Service temporarily stops, the outbox retains undelivered events.
If the Relay Service temporarily stops, the outbox retains undelivered events. Once the Relay Service restarts, it publishes the pending invalidations.
Once the Relay Service restarts, it publishes the pending invalidations. The delay may extend the lifetime of stale cache entries, but it does not permanently lose the invalidation request.
The delay may extend the lifetime of stale cache entries, but it does not permanently lose the invalidation request. Maya added version numbers to reduce the effect of delayed events.
Maya added version numbers to reduce the effect of delayed events. Every Orion record includes a monotonically increasing version.
Every Orion record includes a monotonically increasing version. Helios stores the version alongside the cached value.
Helios stores the version alongside the cached value. An invalidation event also includes the new record version.

An invalidation event also includes the new record version. If Helios receives an old invalidation after a newer value has already been cached, it compares the versions and ignores the outdated event.

If Helios receives an old invalidation after a newer value has already been cached, it compares the versions and ignores the outdated event. This prevents event reordering from removing a newer cached record unnecessarily.
This prevents event reordering from removing a newer cached record unnecessarily. Cache Stampede Protection During early load tests, the team observed a cache stampede.
Cache Stampede Protection During early load tests, the team observed a cache stampede. When a popular record expired, hundreds of Meridian workers missed the same key at nearly the same time.

When a popular record expired, hundreds of Meridian workers missed the same key at nearly the same time. Each miss triggered a separate Orion query, temporarily recreating the original database load problem.
Each miss triggered a separate Orion query, temporarily recreating the original database load problem. Maya introduced request coalescing to prevent this behavior.
Maya introduced request coalescing to prevent this behavior. The first miss for a key creates an in-flight fetch.
The first miss for a key creates an in-flight fetch. Later requests for the same key wait for the existing fetch instead of starting additional database queries.

Later requests for the same key wait for the existing fetch instead of starting additional database queries. When Orion returns the record, Helios completes the cache fill and releases all waiting requests with the same value.

When Orion returns the record, Helios completes the cache fill and releases all waiting requests with the same value. Request coalescing significantly reduced duplicate database reads, but it created a new failure mode.
Request coalescing significantly reduced duplicate database reads, but it created a new failure mode. If the original Orion request stalled, every waiting request for that key also stalled.
If the original Orion request stalled, every waiting request for that key also stalled. To limit the effect, Helios applies a fetch timeout of eight hundred milliseconds.

To limit the effect, Helios applies a fetch timeout of eight hundred milliseconds. After the timeout, waiting requests may either retry through another Helios node or use a controlled fallback path to Orion.
After the timeout, waiting requests may either retry through another Helios node or use a controlled fallback path to Orion. Luis insisted that the fallback path include rate limits.
Luis insisted that the fallback path include rate limits. Without limits, a Helios outage could cause every Meridian worker to contact Orion directly and overwhelm the database.

Without limits, a Helios outage could cause every Meridian worker to contact Orion directly and overwhelm the database. The fallback controller therefore grants a restricted number of direct database requests per customer account.

The fallback controller therefore grants a restricted number of direct database requests per customer account. Requests beyond the limit receive a temporary metadata-unavailable response, which Meridian records without discarding the original telemetry event.

Requests beyond the limit receive a temporary metadata-unavailable response, which Meridian records without discarding the original telemetry event. Failure Handling Helios nodes send heartbeat messages to Sentinel every five seconds.
Failure Handling Helios nodes send heartbeat messages to Sentinel every five seconds. Sentinel marks a node as unhealthy after three consecutive heartbeat failures.
Sentinel marks a node as unhealthy after three consecutive heartbeat failures. When a primary cache node becomes unhealthy, the Cluster Coordinator promotes the most up-to-date replica to primary.

When a primary cache node becomes unhealthy, the Cluster Coordinator promotes the most up-to-date replica to primary. Meridian clients receive the new partition map through the Configuration Distributor.
Meridian clients receive the new partition map through the Configuration Distributor. A promotion can briefly reduce cache availability.
A promotion can briefly reduce cache availability. During this interval, Meridian retries failed lookups using exponential backoff.
During this interval, Meridian retries failed lookups using exponential backoff. The first retry occurs after fifty milliseconds, and later retries increase the delay up to a maximum of one second.

The first retry occurs after fifty milliseconds, and later retries increase the delay up to a maximum of one second. Retries include random jitter so that all workers do not contact the replacement node simultaneously.
Retries include random jitter so that all workers do not contact the replacement node simultaneously. The team also designed a cold-start procedure.
The team also designed a cold-start procedure. If an entire Helios partition loses all replicas, the replacement nodes begin with empty memory.

If an entire Helios partition loses all replicas, the replacement nodes begin with empty memory. Meridian requests gradually refill the partition, but immediate unrestricted traffic could overload Orion.
Meridian requests gradually refill the partition, but immediate unrestricted traffic could overload Orion. During cold start, the Cluster Coordinator activates warm-up mode.
During cold start, the Cluster Coordinator activates warm-up mode. Warm-up mode limits concurrent cache fills and prioritizes records that were most frequently requested before the failure.

Warm-up mode limits concurrent cache fills and prioritizes records that were most frequently requested before the failure. Sentinel identifies high-demand records using request-frequency metrics collected from Helios.

Sentinel identifies high-demand records using request-frequency metrics collected from Helios. It sends the top keys to the Warm-Up Service, which retrieves those records from Orion at a controlled rate.

It sends the top keys to the Warm-Up Service, which retrieves those records from Orion at a controlled rate. This proactive loading reduces the number of user requests that encounter cache misses after recovery.

This proactive loading reduces the number of user requests that encounter cache misses after recovery. The March Load-Test Incident On March 18, the team conducted a production-scale load test using synthetic telemetry.

The March Load-Test Incident On March 18, the team conducted a production-scale load test using synthetic telemetry. The test increased Atlas traffic to fifteen million events per hour and intentionally terminated one Helios primary node.

The test increased Atlas traffic to fifteen million events per hour and intentionally terminated one Helios primary node. The replica promotion completed successfully, but Meridian latency rose sharply several minutes later.
The replica promotion completed successfully, but Meridian latency rose sharply several minutes later. Owen opened an incident channel and asked each service owner to report current metrics.
Owen opened an incident channel and asked each service owner to report current metrics. Sentinel showed that Helios hit rate had fallen from eighty-eight percent to forty-one percent.
Sentinel showed that Helios hit rate had fallen from eighty-eight percent to forty-one percent. Orion query volume had tripled, while the Relay Service appeared healthy.
Orion query volume had tripled, while the Relay Service appeared healthy. At first, the team suspected that the promoted replica had lost data.

At first, the team suspected that the promoted replica had lost data. Luis compared Orion query patterns with the affected cache partition and discovered that most additional queries involved permission records.

Luis compared Orion query patterns with the affected cache partition and discovered that most additional queries involved permission records. Priya then reviewed the deployment configuration and found that permission records in the replacement nodes were expiring after three seconds instead of thirty seconds.

Priya then reviewed the deployment configuration and found that permission records in the replacement nodes were expiring after three seconds instead of thirty seconds. A malformed environment variable had been interpreted as milliseconds by one component and seconds by another.

A malformed environment variable had been interpreted as milliseconds by one component and seconds by another. The short expiration caused frequent misses, and request coalescing could not fully protect Orion because permission requests were distributed across many different keys.

The short expiration caused frequent misses, and request coalescing could not fully protect Orion because permission requests were distributed across many different keys. The team corrected the configuration, restarted the affected replacement nodes, and watched the cache hit rate recover.
The team corrected the configuration, restarted the affected replacement nodes, and watched the cache hit rate recover. Within twelve minutes, Orion query volume returned to its expected range.
Within twelve minutes, Orion query volume returned to its expected range. The incident did not corrupt customer data, but it exposed a gap in configuration validation.

The incident did not corrupt customer data, but it exposed a gap in configuration validation. Sentinel monitored whether records exceeded their maximum lifetime, yet it did not detect expiration values that were unexpectedly short.

Sentinel monitored whether records exceeded their maximum lifetime, yet it did not detect expiration values that were unexpectedly short. After the incident, Priya added lower-bound checks to the Configuration Distributor.

After the incident, Priya added lower-bound checks to the Configuration Distributor. Maya also added an alert that compares observed expiration behavior with the expected policy for each metadata category.

Maya also added an alert that compares observed expiration behavior with the expected policy for each metadata category. Security and Tenant Isolation Testing Because Helios serves many customer accounts, the security team performed dedicated tenant-isolation tests.

Security and Tenant Isolation Testing Because Helios serves many customer accounts, the security team performed dedicated tenant-isolation tests. The tests generated identical equipment identifiers under different accounts and verified that cache lookups returned the correct account-specific records.

The tests generated identical equipment identifiers under different accounts and verified that cache lookups returned the correct account-specific records. They also attempted to submit malformed account identifiers and replay old partition maps.

They also attempted to submit malformed account identifiers and replay old partition maps. One test revealed that a debugging endpoint accepted a cache key without independently verifying the authenticated account.

One test revealed that a debugging endpoint accepted a cache key without independently verifying the authenticated account. The endpoint was available only inside the engineering network, but it could still expose metadata if an internal credential were misused.
The endpoint was available only inside the engineering network, but it could still expose metadata if an internal credential were misused. Priya disabled the endpoint immediately.
Priya disabled the endpoint immediately. Maya replaced it with a diagnostic operation that derives the account identifier from the authenticated request rather than accepting it from user input.

Maya replaced it with a diagnostic operation that derives the account identifier from the authenticated request rather than accepting it from user input. The security team also required audit records for administrative cache invalidations.

The security team also required audit records for administrative cache invalidations. When an operator clears a customer’s cached data, the Administrative Console now records the operator, affected account, reason, timestamp, and number of removed keys.

When an operator clears a customer’s cached data, the Administrative Console now records the operator, affected account, reason, timestamp, and number of removed keys. Sentinel forwards these audit records to the Security Archive, where they are retained for one year.
Sentinel forwards these audit records to the Security Archive, where they are retained for one year. Deployment Plan Northstar decided to deploy Helios gradually.
Deployment Plan Northstar decided to deploy Helios gradually. During the first phase, Meridian continued reading from Orion while also sending shadow lookups to Helios.

During the first phase, Meridian continued reading from Orion while also sending shadow lookups to Helios. Shadow responses were not used for customer results, but they allowed the team to compare cached values with database values.
Shadow responses were not used for customer results, but they allowed the team to compare cached values with database values. Any mismatch was recorded by Sentinel.
Any mismatch was recorded by Sentinel. After the shadow phase produced an acceptable mismatch rate, five percent of customer traffic began using Helios responses.

After the shadow phase produced an acceptable mismatch rate, five percent of customer traffic began using Helios responses. The percentage increased only when latency, hit rate, invalidation delay, and Orion query volume remained within predefined limits.

The percentage increased only when latency, hit rate, invalidation delay, and Orion query volume remained within predefined limits. Owen had authority to pause or reverse the rollout if any safety threshold was exceeded.
Owen had authority to pause or reverse the rollout if any safety threshold was exceeded. The rollout reached fifty percent without a major incident.
The rollout reached fifty percent without a major incident. At that point, Orion query traffic had fallen by forty-six percent and median dashboard latency had improved by twenty-eight percent.

At that point, Orion query traffic had fallen by forty-six percent and median dashboard latency had improved by twenty-eight percent. However, the team observed that a small set of large customers generated most cache traffic.
However, the team observed that a small set of large customers generated most cache traffic. Priya adjusted partition weighting so those customers were distributed more evenly across Helios nodes.
Priya adjusted partition weighting so those customers were distributed more evenly across Helios nodes. At full deployment, Meridian uses Helios as its normal metadata source.
At full deployment, Meridian uses Helios as its normal metadata source. Orion remains the system of record, and all cache misses ultimately depend on Orion.
Orion remains the system of record, and all cache misses ultimately depend on Orion. Helios improves performance and reduces repeated reads, but it does not replace the database.

Helios improves performance and reduces repeated reads, but it does not replace the database. If Helios becomes unavailable, the controlled fallback path preserves limited operation while protecting Orion from uncontrolled traffic.

If Helios becomes unavailable, the controlled fallback path preserves limited operation while protecting Orion from uncontrolled traffic. Operational Lessons The Cache Modernization Project demonstrated that a distributed cache changes more than read performance.

Operational Lessons The Cache Modernization Project demonstrated that a distributed cache changes more than read performance. Helios reduced Orion load, but it also introduced invalidation, version tracking, partition management, failover, warm-up behavior, and new security requirements.

Helios reduced Orion load, but it also introduced invalidation, version tracking, partition management, failover, warm-up behavior, and new security requirements. Each performance optimization created additional consistency or failure-handling responsibilities.
Each performance optimization created additional consistency or failure-handling responsibilities. The project also showed the value of document-wide reasoning.
The project also showed the value of document-wide reasoning. The March incident was not caused by a failed promotion alone.

The March incident was not caused by a failed promotion alone. The promotion introduced replacement nodes, the replacement nodes loaded an incorrect expiration configuration, the short expiration increased permission misses, and the increased misses raised Orion traffic.

The promotion introduced replacement nodes, the replacement nodes loaded an incorrect expiration configuration, the short expiration increased permission misses, and the increased misses raised Orion traffic. Understanding the incident required connecting events and components described in different parts of the system.
Understanding the incident required connecting events and components described in different parts of the system. Northstar now treats cache policy as part of application correctness.

Northstar now treats cache policy as part of application correctness. Changes to expiration, invalidation, fallback limits, and tenant isolation require review from both the platform and database teams.

Changes to expiration, invalidation, fallback limits, and tenant isolation require review from both the platform and database teams. Sentinel continues to monitor cache hit rate, invalidation delay, record lifetime, node health, fallback usage, and Orion query volume.

Sentinel continues to monitor cache hit rate, invalidation delay, record lifetime, node health, fallback usage, and Orion query volume. The final system achieved its original performance goal, but the team considered operational safety the more important result.

The final system achieved its original performance goal, but the team considered operational safety the more important result. Helios improved dashboard speed because it reused metadata across Meridian workers.

Helios improved dashboard speed because it reused metadata across Meridian workers. It remained reliable because Orion stayed authoritative, Aurora carried durable invalidations, version numbers handled reordered events, request coalescing reduced duplicate fills, and rate-limited fallback protected the database during failures.
